title: Synthetos TinyG post processor (3-axis mill)

labels.name: in-review

body:
### What are you trying to do

Post 3-axis milling programs for machines running [Synthetos TinyG](https://github.com/synthetos/TinyG) (the TinyG v8 board, ATxmega192A3), the other grbl-family hobby controller. CamCraft has no TinyG post; #710's grblHAL post is the closest, but TinyG understands a smaller set again: no canned cycles at all (G81-G89 are rejected), no G41/G42, no G84, `M6` only records the tool, tool numbers stop at 31, and the serial input acts on `!`, `~` and `%` wherever they stand in a line.

The firmware's `edge-next` branch (build 450.03) is what I maintain and test on real boards, so posted programs can be checked against its own parser and planner off the board, and on a board after that.

### How you imagine it working

A new `assets/posts/tinyg.cps` (3-axis mill), structured like `grblhal.cps` and specced from TinyG's public wiki ("Gcode Support", "Homing and Limits", "Flow Control and Footers", "Inch and Millimeter Units Mode") and the LinuxCNC G-code reference TinyG states it follows (behaviour only; the firmware source is GPL and is not read for this), plus a generic `assets/machines/tinyg-3axis.mch`.

What the post respects (each checked against the wiki and by replaying the output through the edge-next parser and planner):
- **Drilling as plain moves**: a CYCLE record writes nothing; the hole's expanded chain posts, with the dwell as `G4 P<seconds>` at the hole bottom. Tapping is refused by name (no G84, no spindle sync).
- **Tool change**: Z lift, then `T<n> M6` alone on its line, then `M0` on the next - M6 moves nothing on TinyG, so the stop is the operator's change. Tools T1-T31; a larger number is refused by name.
- **Header `G21|G20 G17 G90 G91.1 G94 G64`**: the words M30 does not reset on TinyG. No `%`, O word or N numbers; no tool length word (G43.1/G49 belong to the operator or sender, as #710 decided for grblHAL).
- **Z lift as grblHAL's**: `G53 G0 Z<safe_retract>` only when the machine file states it; otherwise the work-offset clearance, refused by name when unknown or not above the stock. No G28/G30.
- **Comments** drop `!` (feed hold), `~` (cycle start), `%` (queue flush) and the other characters the serial input acts on; lines stay under 191 bytes.
- Refused by name: control/wear compensation, going home, tilted moves; probing is refused by the engine (no parameters or expressions on TinyG).

**Done means:** `tinyg.cps` and the machine file ship in `assets/`; the post is in the conformance list (tap refused), `EXTENSIONS` and the cross-post tests like `grblhal`; a `tinyg_post` test and goldens under `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tinyg/` cover contour, pocket, face, slot, trace, drill, peck and tool change; every golden replays through the edge-next firmware's parser and planner with no refused line.

Related: #710 (grblHAL post; this stacks on #715, which it extends the same lists as), #714.

Filed from a fork, which cannot set labels. Suggested labels: enhancement, P2, area:post.
